notes: This is a typescript with numerous typed interlinear changes and handwritten mathematical fills, corrections and connecting curves. No date or author page number is visible. The heading begins Interprétations en termes de filtrations du foncteur oubli; the deleted sur la catégorie remains legible. The lower-left 17 is recorded only as an archive-number comment.

The first paragraph considers tensor-compatible exact filtrations in a fixed rational conjugacy class, relates the class to Hom(G_m,T_o)/W, and describes filtration, one-parameter-subgroup and Levi-couple schemes. It states that two canonical forgetful maps are isomorphic. These assertions are reported as what the page says, not independently established theorems.

The second paragraph assumes characteristic zero and explicitly hesitates: "j'ignore dans quelle mesure c'est vraiment nécessaire". It introduces Dyn_c, adds the non-point and nontrivial-class conditions, replaces underlined torseur by espace homogène, and begins a statement about Un_c that continues beyond the page.

The handwritten stabilizer note reads "il faudrait regarder la structure de ces Z_o; dimension, semi-simplicité". It is a question for further study. The old parenthesis claiming a torsor identification with Isom(G_1,G) is cancelled and remains fully transcribed.

Typed slips retained include fixé une classe, rationelle, Auext, morphismesde and the grave in où un sous-groupe. The plural foncteurs and unaccented fibres are preserved. The last vowel before foncteurs is an unresolved a/e overprint, not silently normalized to du or des.

The small mark before Cent(i) is lighter, smaller and more oblique than the definite full stop after the expression. It is preserved as a doubtful graphic spot, not promoted to a definite stop. The solid following full stop and handwritten closing parenthesis are retained.

The apparent Gamma prime would introduce a distinction not explained on this sheet. This was noticed during reading, but the decision came from the continuous top-arm/terminal contour in the required crop, not from mathematical expectation.

marked_in_H denotes an explicit H uncertainty remark. H's note calls the long parabolic insertion hard to read and mentions c'est and soit c'; ordinary add/struck macros alone are not counted as uncertainty marks.
The supplied C questions repeat the da/du locus twice and include several spelling cautions without unsure macros. All are addressed in c_doubts, along with the explicit first-tensor doubt in C.tex.
The procedural interruption caused no loss of retained context. No whole or half was reloaded, no other reader or page was inspected, and all 22 prepared crops were viewed exactly once.
